question.text: The family of curves \(y=e^{a \sin x}\), where ' \(a\) ' is arbitrary constant, is represented by the differential equation

solution.text: \(\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow \log y=a \sin x \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{d}{d x}\left(\frac{\log y}{\sin x}\right)=\frac{d}{d x}(a) \Rightarrow \frac{\sin x\left(\frac{d y}{d x}\right)}{y}-\log y \times \cos x=0 \\ & \Rightarrow y \log y=\tan x \times \frac{d y}{d x}\end{aligned}\)
